description:
File: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs:207, crate-jmap-chat-server/src/lib.rs:244
Issue: Both crates re-export ClosureHandler from jmap_server and their respective register_*_handlers functions document that CallerCtx is not forwarded. However, the ClosureHandler type itself is re-exported pub from both domain crates (last line of each lib.rs), making it available to consumers of jmap-mail-server and jmap-chat-server without those consumers necessarily reading the register_mail_handlers or register_chat_handlers doc comments. A consumer who assembles their own dispatcher using ClosureHandler directly will write code that silently drops their auth context.
Risk: The limitation is documented in the right place (register_*_handlers docstring) but the export of ClosureHandler from domain crates creates a secondary entry point that lacks the warning. Future maintainers adding per-request auth will search for ClosureHandler usages and may not notice the type-level limitation.
Fix: Add a doc comment on ClosureHandler itself (in jmap-server) that prominently states the CallerCtx limitation; the domain crate re-exports then carry the warning automatically. Alternatively, do not re-export ClosureHandler from domain crates if it has no domain-specific use — keep it pub(crate) in jmap-server.
title: ClosureHandler CallerCtx limitation undocumented at registration site
